title: Gateway SDK options
responsibility: Builds isolated SDK options for a local Claude gateway session.

inputs.name: gatewayOptions.session
inputs.description: The GatewaySession whose controller becomes the abortController of the SDK request, so aborting session.controller aborts that request. Only session.controller is read, and session is not checked for null or undefined.

outputs.name: gatewayOptions
outputs.description: Isolated SDK options for a local Claude gateway session: tools and settingSources are empty arrays, persistSession is false, includePartialMessages is true, model is claude-opus-5-5, effort is xhigh, permissionMode is dontAsk, cwd is /tmp, extraArgs sets strict-mcp-config and no-chrome to null, and abortController is session.controller. The env is a shallow copy of process.env without variables whose names start with ANTHROPIC_ or CLAUDE_CODE_USE_ and without CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN; pathToClaudeCodeExecutable is HARNESS_CLAUDE_EXECUTABLE when that is not null or undefined, otherwise $HOME/.local/bin/claude, and neither HOME nor the executable path is validated; abortController is omitted from the examples because JSON cannot carry an AbortController.
